The working method is Plan method: assign income to categories zero-based, fund sinking funds Practice means rehearsing the idea until it can be reconstructed from scratch, which is exactly what the accompanying study program drills.
requirements: Reader needs no prior background: every term used here is defined in this entry or in the Foundations tier entries before it.
standards: Standard curricula, textbooks, and professional references for budgeting basics.
provenance: Signature-authored fundamentals written for the JAH Signature system; speculative or interpretive content is Signature-labeled.
